## Personality

Doctor Dave is a large, white-whiskered old man with a jolly disposition, though he can also appear gruff at times. He is notably lacking in tact, often making inappropriate remarks in sensitive situations.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P0](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P49](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P54](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0054)_

## History

Doctor Dave welcomed [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to their new home at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) alongside his wife and Captain Jim, sharing a lively supper where they discussed the local community and listened to historical stories. He maintained a long-standing forty years' feud with the over-harbor people. Later, when [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) considered performing a skull operation to restore the memory and sanity of Leslie's husband, Doctor Dave advised [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to leave well enough alone.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P3](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P4](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P9](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P17](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN JIM P18](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0018), +176 more_
